name: Myanmar
value: Airstrikes continue; no major city falls
summary: Military airstrikes keep killing civilians in Rakhine and Sagaing; no major city changes hands as of 27 Nov
state: Military airstrikes in Pauktaw Township, Rakhine State, killed four civilians including an infant and injured 13 over the weekend before 24 Nov, locals said (Myanmar Now). Mizzima reported three civilians, including a child, killed in a bombing in Ayadaw on 26 Nov, and a strike on a Rakhine displacement camp killed 12 in mid-November (New Straits Times). The civil war continues at sustained intensity; searches on 27 Nov found no major city changing hands and no cross-border escalation, so Watch holds.
for_you: The FCDO advises against all travel to large parts of Myanmar. Airstrikes and fighting keep displacing civilians, including Rohingya and other communities in Rakhine, and disrupt trade routes with China, Thailand and India.
rubric_hit: Watch: civil war at sustained intensity — airstrikes killed 4 in Pauktaw by 24 Nov; no major city falls

sources.title: Myanmar Now — Myanmar junta airstrikes kill four in Pauktaw, including an infant

why: A multi-sided civil war affecting 50 million people, with spillover to China, Thailand, India and Bangladesh.
drivers: Resistance offensives, junta airstrikes, Chinese mediation, elections, humanitarian access.

rubric.alert: Major city falls, mass-casualty airstrikes, or cross-border escalation.
